assets.title: Streak
assets.prompt: Edit this calendar classroom illustration. Keep the square framing, warm flat storybook style, two middle-school students, coral and mustard hoodies, calendar with six coral squares then one empty square, all artwork text-free. Correct TWO details. 1. Give the student on the LEFT one coherent short rounded natural curly bob around her head, ending just below her ears, with a clear natural hairline. REMOVE the bun, headband, ponytail and all trailing hair behind her shoulder; no stacked or disconnected hair masses. Her arms stay relaxed at her sides. 2. Student on the RIGHT in mustard hoodie should naturally point at the empty square with ONE hand. Turn her torso slightly toward the calendar so the raised near arm has a completely visible continuous silhouette from its OWN shoulder at the outer top of her torso through a normal upper arm, bent elbow, forearm, wrist and pointing index finger. Elbow below shoulder, forearm rises diagonally toward calendar, normal proportions. The raised sleeve MUST join the shoulder of the hoodie, never originate from neck, chest or opposite shoulder. Her other arm hangs naturally by her side. Exactly two arms and two hands per person. Hands anatomically plausible and unambiguous. Leave some clear space around pointing arm so its connection to her body can be read. Keep dark-haired student's long hair tucked behind her shoulder so it does not obscure that arm. No text, labels, numerals, logos.
assets.alt: A student with short curls watches another student point to the empty square after six filled calendar squares.

assets.title: Autoplay
assets.prompt: Redesign this square educational illustration to fix its awkward anatomy and impossible laptop viewing arrangement. Keep the warm flat storybook illustration, muted teal coral mustard navy palette, and middle-school age audience. Use a clear over-the-shoulder composition: one red-haired student in a teal hoodie seated naturally at a desk, seen from behind and slightly to the side, looking toward an open laptop. The student and viewer both see the SAME front of the screen. Both hands rest naturally on the desk beside the laptop, no pointing, no hand overlaps the screen. Laptop is large and visually dominant with plausible hinge, keyboard and screen perspective. On screen show only two plain colored rectangular cards, the first fading/sliding out and the second sliding in, plus a small curved arrow indicating automatic advance. No video content, no letters, no words, no numerals, no logos. Simplify the background to a softly colored classroom wall with one blank noticeboard. No extra students. Clean uncluttered readable silhouette; ordinary anatomically sound hands and arms. This is the autoplay glossary image.
assets.alt: Seen over a student’s shoulder, a laptop shows two plain cards and a curved arrow for automatic advance. Both hands rest beside the keyboard.
